title: 2026 ACM International Conference on Neuromorphic Systems (ICONS)
summary: The 2026 ACM ICONS conference is scheduled for August 4–6 in Chicago. The event focuses on neuromorphic computing architectures, models, applications, energy-efficient AI, edge computing, and brain-inspired computation. A call for papers has been issued to researchers, engineers, and students.
tldr: The 2026 ACM ICONS conference will be held August 4–6 in Chicago covering neuromorphic systems research.
evidence: The conference will take place August 4–6 in Chicago, IL.
ICONS is the premier venue for researchers advancing neuromorphic computing.
